fit.reason: Operating revenue, margins, cash conversion and reinvestment drive value; business-specific accounting and financing adjustments remain necessary. Ferguson changed its fiscal year-end from July 31 to December 31. Its August–December 2025 five-month transition filing is a stub, and January–June 2026 is the new calendar-year YTD period. The old July fiscal year cannot be rolled into a June TTM by adding calendar H1 and subtracting an unmatched prior fiscal YTD. The business is not treated as a merger solely because its reporting calendar changed; recent reported facts remain distinct from a compatible full-year valuation base, with no annualization.
